_comment: LIVE watchlist of REAL Polymarket markets (default when --live-odds is passed). Each token uses the real CLOB 'token_id' hash from Gamma (market.clobTokenIds) and the on-chain 'condition_id' (market.conditionId); there is NO 'mock_price'. 'model' maps the outcome to the model probability ('home'|'draw'|'away' or a '+'-combo). NOTE: Polymarket markets/token ids are ephemeral -- refresh from https://gamma-api.polymarket.com/events?slug=<slug> before a real run, and flip 'is_active' to false once a match has concluded.
